Roth]] | after_party = Republican Party (United States) }} The '''1994 United States Senate election in Delaware''' was held November 8, 1994. Incumbent Senator [[William Roth]] won re-election to a fifth term. He was the first Delaware senator to do so, becoming the longest serving before being overtaken by [[Joe Biden]] in [[2002 United States Senate election in Delaware|2002]]. As of {{CURRENTYEAR}}, this was the last time Republicans won a U.S. Senate election in [[Delaware]]. == Candidates == === Democratic === * [[Charles Oberly]], [[Attorney General of Delaware]] === Republican === * [[William V.
